$comment: Registry of the Railway project's services and environments.
Single source of truth for the IDs that used to be copy-pasted into
every script and workflow. Service/environment names are what Railway
shows in the dashboard; IDs are stable even if a name is changed.
TO RE-DERIVE ANY ID YOURSELF, ask nobody: open the project URL below,
switch the environment dropdown, and read environmentId= out of the
address bar. A service id is in the URL the same way once you open it.
Both environment ids here were wrong until 2026-09-23 and every deploy
failed with 'Environment "<id>" not found.' - which is exactly what a
wrong id looks like. If you see that error, re-derive rather than guess.
